Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Public Const ERR_SAME_FY  As Long = vbObjectError + 1001
Public Const ERR_CANCELED As Long = vbObjectError + 1002

Private Sub ValidateFYs(sourceFY As Integer, targetFY As Integer)
    If sourceFY = targetFY Then
        Err.Raise ERR_SAME_FY, "basDataOperations", _
                  "Source and target fiscal years must differ (got " & sourceFY & ")."
    End If
End Sub


' Returns number of rows copied.
' Raises ERR_CANCELED on user cancel; ERR_SAME_FY on equal FYs.
Public Function CopyProviderCatalog(ProviderID As Long, _
                                    sourceFY As Integer, _
                                    targetFY As Integer, _
                                    Optional ByVal overwrite As Variant) As Long
    Dim cn As ADODB.Connection
    Dim rsSource As ADODB.Recordset
    Dim rsTarget As ADODB.Recordset
    Dim fld As ADODB.Field
    Dim transactionActive As Boolean
    Dim rowsCopied As Long

    ' Buffer the source rows so we can close rsSource before BeginTrans.
    Dim sourceRows() As Variant
    Dim sourceCount As Long
    Dim fieldNames() As String
    Dim fieldCount As Long

    ValidateFYs sourceFY, targetFY

    Set cn = CurrentProject.Connection

    Set rsSource = New ADODB.Recordset
    rsSource.Open "SELECT ProviderID, ServiceID, RatePerHour, Notes " & _
                  "FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog " & _
                  "WHERE ProviderID=" & ProviderID & _
                  "  AND FiscalYear=" & sourceFY, _
                  cn, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly

    If rsSource.EOF Then
        rsSource.Close
        Set rsSource = Nothing
        CopyProviderCatalog = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' Snapshot field names + values, then close the read cursor.
    fieldCount = rsSource.Fields.count
    ReDim fieldNames(0 To fieldCount - 1)
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 0 To fieldCount - 1
        fieldNames(i) = rsSource.Fields(i).name
    Next i

    ReDim sourceRows(0 To fieldCount - 1, 0 To 1023)
    Do Until rsSource.EOF
        If sourceCount > UBound(sourceRows, 2) Then
            ReDim Preserve sourceRows(0 To fieldCount - 1, 0 To sourceCount + 1023)
        End If
        For i = 0 To fieldCount - 1
            sourceRows(i, sourceCount) = rsSource.Fields(i).Value
        Next i
        sourceCount = sourceCount + 1
        rsSource.MoveNext
    Loop
    rsSource.Close
    Set rsSource = Nothing

    ' --- Target check / overwrite decision ---
    Dim targetExists As Long
    targetExists = DCount("*", "tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
                          "ProviderID=" & ProviderID & " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY)

    If targetExists > 0 Then
        Dim doOverwrite As Boolean
        If IsMissing(overwrite) Then
            doOverwrite = (MsgBox("A catalog for Provider " & ProviderID & _
                                  " in FY" & targetFY & " already exists. Overwrite?", _
                                  vbExclamation + vbOKCancel + vbDefaultButton2, _
                                  "Overwrite Existing Catalog?") = vbOK)
        Else
            doOverwrite = CBool(overwrite)
        End If
        If Not doOverwrite Then
            Err.Raise ERR_CANCELED, "CopyProviderCatalog", "User canceled overwrite."
        End If
    End If

    On Error GoTo CopyError

    cn.BeginTrans
    transactionActive = True

    If targetExists > 0 Then
        cn.Execute "DELETE FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog " & _
                   "WHERE ProviderID=" & ProviderID & _
                   "  AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY, _
                   , adExecuteNoRecords
    End If

    ' Empty-shaped target for AddNew
    Set rsTarget = New ADODB.Recordset
    rsTarget.Open "SELECT ProviderServiceCatalogID, ProviderID, ServiceID, " & _
                  "       FiscalYear, RatePerHour, Notes " & _
                  "FROM tblProviderServiceCatalog WHERE 1=0", _
                  cn, adOpenKeyset, adLockOptimistic

    Dim r As Long
    For r = 0 To sourceCount - 1
        rsTarget.AddNew
        For i = 0 To fieldCount - 1
            Select Case LCase$(fieldNames(i))
                Case "providerservicecatalogid"
                    ' identity � never copy
                Case Else
                    rsTarget.Fields(fieldNames(i)).Value = sourceRows(i, r)
            End Select
        Next i
        rsTarget!FiscalYear = targetFY
        rsTarget.Update
        rowsCopied = rowsCopied + 1
    Next r

    cn.CommitTrans
    transactionActive = False

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not rsTarget Is Nothing Then
        If rsTarget.State = adStateOpen Then rsTarget.Close
    End If
    Set rsTarget = Nothing
    Set cn = Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0

    CopyProviderCatalog = rowsCopied
    Exit Function

CopyError:
    Dim savedErr As Long, savedDesc As String, savedSrc As String
    savedErr = Err.Number
    savedDesc = Err.Description
    savedSrc = Err.Source

    If transactionActive Then
        On Error Resume Next
        cn.RollbackTrans
        On Error GoTo 0
        transactionActive = False
    End If

    On Error Resume Next
    If Not rsTarget Is Nothing Then
        If rsTarget.State = adStateOpen Then rsTarget.Close
    End If
    Set rsTarget = Nothing
    Set cn = Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0

    Err.Raise savedErr, savedSrc, savedDesc
End Function


' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  MostRecentPopulatedFY
'
'  Returns the largest FiscalYear in tableName matching scopeWhere, optionally
'  excluding excludeFY (so the "current" target year doesn't qualify as its
'  own source). Returns Null if no matching rows exist.
'
'  Example:
'    srcFY = MostRecentPopulatedFY("tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
'                                   "ProviderID=" & Me.ProviderID, _
'                                   targetFY)
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Public Function MostRecentPopulatedFY(tableName As String, _
                                       scopeWhere As String, _
                                       Optional excludeFY As Variant) As Variant
    Dim sql As String
    Dim where As String

    where = scopeWhere
    If Not IsMissing(excludeFY) Then
        If Len(where) > 0 Then where = where & " AND "
        where = where & "FiscalYear < " & CLng(excludeFY)
    End If

    If Len(where) > 0 Then where = " WHERE " & where

    sql = "SELECT MAX(FiscalYear) AS MaxFY FROM " & tableName & where

    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset(sql, dbOpenSnapshot)

    If rs.EOF Then
        MostRecentPopulatedFY = Null
    Else
        MostRecentPopulatedFY = rs!MaxFY    ' Null if no rows matched
    End If

    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
End Function
Public Function CopyClientNeedsAndPlans(ClientID As Long, _
                                         sourceFY As Integer, _
                                         targetFY As Integer, _
                                         Optional ByVal overwrite As Variant, _
                                         Optional ByRef plansCopied As Long, _
                                         Optional ByRef plansSkipped As Long) As Long
    Dim ws As DAO.Workspace
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rsSource As DAO.Recordset
    Dim rsTarget As DAO.Recordset
    Dim rsPlans As DAO.Recordset
    Dim transactionActive As Boolean
    Dim needsCopied As Long
    Dim sourceNotes As String
    Dim targetStart As Variant
    Dim oldNeedID As Long
    Dim newNeedID As Long
    Dim newCatID As Variant
    Dim newPlanNotes As String

    plansCopied = 0
    plansSkipped = 0

    targetStart = DLookup("StartDate", "tlkpFiscalYears", "FiscalYear=" & targetFY)
    If IsNull(targetStart) Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 1003, "CopyClientNeedsAndPlans", _
                  "FY" & targetFY & " is not defined in tlkpFiscalYears."
    End If

    ValidateFYs sourceFY, targetFY

    Set ws = DBEngine.Workspaces(0)
    Set db = ws(0)

    ' --- Source check ---
    Set rsSource = db.OpenRecordset( _
        "SELECT * FROM tblClientServiceNeeds " & _
        "WHERE ClientID=" & ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & sourceFY, _
        dbOpenSnapshot)

    If rsSource.EOF Then
        GoTo Cleanup    ' nothing to copy; return 0
    End If

    ' --- Target check / overwrite decision ---
    Dim targetNeedCount As Long, targetPlanCount As Long
    targetNeedCount = DCount("*", "tblClientServiceNeeds", _
                             "ClientID=" & ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY)
    targetPlanCount = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", _
                             "ClientServiceNeedID IN (SELECT ClientServiceNeedID " & _
                             "FROM tblClientServiceNeeds WHERE ClientID=" & ClientID & _
                             " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY & ")")

    If targetNeedCount > 0 Or targetPlanCount > 0 Then
        Dim doOverwrite As Boolean
        If IsMissing(overwrite) Then
            doOverwrite = (MsgBox("FY" & targetFY & " already has " & targetNeedCount & _
                                  " service need(s) and " & targetPlanCount & _
                                  " plan row(s) for this client." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                                  "Replace them with the FY" & sourceFY & " data?", _
                                  vbExclamation + vbOKCancel + vbDefaultButton2, _
                                  "Overwrite Existing Needs and Plans?") = vbOK)
        Else
            doOverwrite = CBool(overwrite)
        End If
        If Not doOverwrite Then
            Err.Raise ERR_CANCELED, "CopyClientNeedsAndPlans", "User canceled overwrite."
        End If
    End If

    On Error GoTo CopyError

    ws.BeginTrans
    transactionActive = True

    ' Delete plans first (FK), then needs.
    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblClientServicePlan " & _
               "WHERE ClientServiceNeedID IN (" & _
               "  SELECT ClientServiceNeedID FROM tblClientServiceNeeds " & _
               "  WHERE ClientID=" & ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY & ")", _
               dbFailOnError

    db.Execute "DELETE FROM tblClientServiceNeeds " & _
               "WHERE ClientID=" & ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY, _
               dbFailOnError

    Set rsTarget = db.OpenRecordset("tblClientServiceNeeds", dbOpenDynaset, dbAppendOnly)

    Do While Not rsSource.EOF
        oldNeedID = rsSource!ClientServiceNeedID
        sourceNotes = Nz(rsSource!Notes, "")

        rsTarget.AddNew
        rsTarget!ClientID = rsSource!ClientID
        rsTarget!ServiceID = rsSource!ServiceID
        rsTarget!FiscalYear = targetFY
        rsTarget!Priority = rsSource!Priority
        rsTarget!DaysOfWeek = rsSource!DaysOfWeek
        rsTarget!PreferredTimeStart = rsSource!PreferredTimeStart
        rsTarget!PreferredTimeEnd = rsSource!PreferredTimeEnd
        rsTarget!HoursPerWeek = rsSource!HoursPerWeek
        If Len(sourceNotes) > 0 Then
            rsTarget!Notes = sourceNotes & " (Copied from FY" & sourceFY & ")"
        Else
            rsTarget!Notes = "Copied from FY" & sourceFY
        End If
        rsTarget.Update

        ' Capture the new autonumber for FK remapping in the plan copy.
        rsTarget.Bookmark = rsTarget.LastModified
        newNeedID = rsTarget!ClientServiceNeedID

        ' Plan copy: walk source plans, look up target catalog row via DLookup,
        ' insert one by one. (Replaces a 3-table self-join INSERT-SELECT that
        ' Jet rejected with "JOIN expression not supported" - see lessons-learned.md.)
        Set rsPlans = db.OpenRecordset( _
            "SELECT p.HoursPerWeek, p.Status, p.Notes, " & _
            "       srcCat.ProviderID AS SrcProvID, srcCat.ServiceID AS SrcSvcID " & _
            "FROM tblClientServicePlan AS p " & _
            "  INNER JOIN tblProviderServiceCatalog AS srcCat " & _
            "    ON p.ProviderServiceCatalogID = srcCat.ProviderServiceCatalogID " & _
            "WHERE p.ClientServiceNeedID = " & oldNeedID, _
            dbOpenSnapshot)

        Do While Not rsPlans.EOF
            newCatID = DLookup("ProviderServiceCatalogID", "tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
                               "ProviderID=" & rsPlans!SrcProvID & _
                               " AND ServiceID=" & rsPlans!SrcSvcID & _
                               " AND FiscalYear=" & targetFY)

            If IsNull(newCatID) Then
                plansSkipped = plansSkipped + 1
            Else
                If Len(Nz(rsPlans!Notes, "")) > 0 Then
                    newPlanNotes = rsPlans!Notes & " (Copied from FY" & sourceFY & ")"
                Else
                    newPlanNotes = "Copied from FY" & sourceFY
                End If

                ' Insert with ApprovalDate=Null so the BeforeChange data macro
                ' resets Status to "Pending". WeeklyCost / AnnualEstCost are
                ' left to the macro to compute from the target FY's catalog rate.
                db.Execute _
                    "INSERT INTO tblClientServicePlan " & _
                    "  (ClientServiceNeedID, ProviderServiceCatalogID, FiscalYear, " & _
                    "   HoursPerWeek, ApprovalDate, ApprovedBy, Status, Notes) " & _
                    "VALUES (" & _
                    newNeedID & ", " & CLng(newCatID) & ", " & targetFY & ", " & _
                    Nz(rsPlans!HoursPerWeek, 0) & ", " & _
                    "Null, Null, " & _
                    "'" & Replace(Nz(rsPlans!Status, "Pending"), "'", "''") & "', " & _
                    "'" & Replace(newPlanNotes, "'", "''") & "')", _
                    dbFailOnError
                plansCopied = plansCopied + 1
            End If
            rsPlans.MoveNext
        Loop
        rsPlans.Close
        Set rsPlans = Nothing

        needsCopied = needsCopied + 1
        rsSource.MoveNext
    Loop

    ws.CommitTrans
    transactionActive = False

Cleanup:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not rsSource Is Nothing Then rsSource.Close
    If Not rsTarget Is Nothing Then rsTarget.Close
    If Not rsPlans Is Nothing Then rsPlans.Close
    Set rsSource = Nothing
    Set rsTarget = Nothing
    Set rsPlans = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    Set ws = Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0

    CopyClientNeedsAndPlans = needsCopied
    Exit Function

CopyError:
    Dim savedErr As Long, savedDesc As String, savedSrc As String
    savedErr = Err.Number
    savedDesc = Err.Description
    savedSrc = Err.Source

    If transactionActive Then
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Rollback
        On Error GoTo 0
        transactionActive = False
    End If

    On Error Resume Next
    If Not rsSource Is Nothing Then rsSource.Close
    If Not rsTarget Is Nothing Then rsTarget.Close
    If Not rsPlans Is Nothing Then rsPlans.Close
    Set rsSource = Nothing
    Set rsTarget = Nothing
    Set rsPlans = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    Set ws = Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0

    Err.Raise savedErr, savedSrc, savedDesc
End Function


' ============================================================
' ADODB-BASED OPERATIONS
' Uses ADODB for rate limit copying - intentionally different
' from DAO to exercise both migration paths
' ============================================================

' Returns number of rate-limit rows copied.
' Raises ERR_CANCELED on user cancel; ERR_SAME_FY on equal FYs.
Public Function CopyServiceRateLimits(sourceFY As Integer, _
                                      targetFY As Integer, _
                                      Optional ByVal overwrite As Variant) As Long
    Dim cn As ADODB.Connection
    Dim rsSource As ADODB.Recordset
    Dim cmdInsert As ADODB.Command
    Dim transactionActive As Boolean
    Dim rowsCopied As Long

    ' Buffer source rows so we can close rsSource before BeginTrans.
    Dim serviceIds() As Long
    Dim maxRates() As Currency
    Dim Notes() As Variant
    Dim sourceCount As Long
    Const CHUNK As Long = 256

    ValidateFYs sourceFY, targetFY

    Set cn = CurrentProject.Connection

    Set rsSource = New ADODB.Recordset
    rsSource.Open "SELECT ServiceID, MaxRatePerHour, Notes " & _
                  "FROM tblServiceRateLimits " & _
                  "WHERE FiscalYear=" & sourceFY, _
                  cn, adOpenStatic, adLockReadOnly

    If rsSource.EOF Then
        rsSource.Close
        Set rsSource = Nothing
        CopyServiceRateLimits = 0
        Exit Function
    End If

    ReDim serviceIds(0 To CHUNK - 1)
    ReDim maxRates(0 To CHUNK - 1)
    ReDim Notes(0 To CHUNK - 1)

    Do Until rsSource.EOF
        If sourceCount > UBound(serviceIds) Then
            ReDim Preserve serviceIds(0 To sourceCount + CHUNK - 1)
            ReDim Preserve maxRates(0 To sourceCount + CHUNK - 1)
            ReDim Preserve Notes(0 To sourceCount + CHUNK - 1)
        End If
        serviceIds(sourceCount) = CLng(rsSource!ServiceID)
        maxRates(sourceCount) = CCur(Nz(rsSource!MaxRatePerHour, 0))
        Notes(sourceCount) = rsSource!Notes
        sourceCount = sourceCount + 1
        rsSource.MoveNext
    Loop
    rsSource.Close
    Set rsSource = Nothing

    ' --- Target check / overwrite decision ---
    Dim targetExists As Long
    targetExists = DCount("*", "tblServiceRateLimits", "FiscalYear=" & targetFY)

    If targetExists > 0 Then
        Dim doOverwrite As Boolean
        If IsMissing(overwrite) Then
            doOverwrite = (MsgBox("A service rate record for FY" & targetFY & _
                                  " already exists. Overwrite?", _
                                  vbExclamation + vbOKCancel + vbDefaultButton2, _
                                  "Overwrite Existing Records?") = vbOK)
        Else
            doOverwrite = CBool(overwrite)
        End If
        If Not doOverwrite Then
            Err.Raise ERR_CANCELED, "CopyServiceRateLimits", "User canceled overwrite."
        End If
    End If

    ' --- Prepared insert command ---
    Set cmdInsert = New ADODB.Command
    With cmdInsert
        Set .ActiveConnection = cn
        .CommandType = adCmdText
        .CommandText = "INSERT INTO tblServiceRateLimits " & _
                       "(ServiceID, FiscalYear, MaxRatePerHour, Notes) " & _
                       "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)"
        .Parameters.Append .CreateParameter("p1", adInteger, adParamInput, , 0)
        .Parameters.Append .CreateParameter("p2", adInteger, adParamInput, , targetFY)
        .Parameters.Append .CreateParameter("p3", adCurrency, adParamInput, , 0)
        .Parameters.Append .CreateParameter("p4", adLongVarWChar, adParamInput, 1073741823, "")
    End With

    On Error GoTo CopyError

    cn.BeginTrans
    transactionActive = True

    If targetExists > 0 Then
        cn.Execute "DELETE FROM tblServiceRateLimits WHERE FiscalYear=" & targetFY, _
                   , adExecuteNoRecords
    End If

    Dim r As Long
    For r = 0 To sourceCount - 1
        cmdInsert.Parameters("p1").Value = serviceIds(r)
        cmdInsert.Parameters("p2").Value = targetFY
        cmdInsert.Parameters("p3").Value = maxRates(r)
        cmdInsert.Parameters("p4").Value = Notes(r)
        cmdInsert.Execute , , adExecuteNoRecords
        rowsCopied = rowsCopied + 1
    Next r

    cn.CommitTrans
    transactionActive = False

Cleanup:
    Set cmdInsert = Nothing
    Set cn = Nothing
    CopyServiceRateLimits = rowsCopied
    Exit Function

CopyError:
    Dim savedErr As Long, savedDesc As String, savedSrc As String
    savedErr = Err.Number
    savedDesc = Err.Description
    savedSrc = Err.Source

    If transactionActive Then
        On Error Resume Next
        cn.RollbackTrans
        On Error GoTo 0
        transactionActive = False
    End If

    Set cmdInsert = Nothing
    Set cn = Nothing

    Err.Raise savedErr, savedSrc, savedDesc
End Function
